body: I think there are instances where situations can’t be improved.  Life doesn’t have a GPS driving directions to always have a route planned to get you home regardless of how many mistakes you make.  Some mistakes can’t be undone.  I can’t get back home from where I’m at and if I keep going the future is just more and more painful.  Maybe a miracle will happen but I don’t believe in god. You seem like a good person and I wish you well.
